tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Body background behind every edition.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Plate ground behind feature art and comic panels; US map land fill.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Running head bar and cards set above paper.

tokens.name: tabon
tokens.usage: Ground of the active tab in the running head.

tokens.name: tabon-white
tokens.usage: Popups and dialogs that sit above the page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headlines on paper, cream and bar. 15.4:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: dek, margin labels, captions, page numbers. 5.3:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: index rows, plate borders, prose section rules, button outlines.

tokens.name: barrule
tokens.usage: Bottom rule of the running head bar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Default accent when no story tint applies: links, kicker, prose subheads, focus ring. Each story overrides it with its tint. 6.5:1 light, 9.1:1 dark on paper.

tokens.name: mem
tokens.usage: Marks material only in the full (members) edition: the Letter tab and the Full issue tag. 6.7:1 light, 8.2:1 dark on paper.

tokens.name: tint-gregory
tokens.usage: Story tint, set as --accent on the Race amity: The Louis Gregory Bahá'í Institute feature section: chapter rule and numeral, kicker, listen button, running-head tab underline. Same in both themes. As text it is 3.27:1 on light paper, below 4.5:1; keep it to large numerals, rules and fills there.

tokens.name: tint-newyorkers
tokens.usage: Story tint, set as --accent on the Community: New Yorkers create more unified communities through the arts section: chapter rule and numeral, kicker, listen button, running-head tab underline. Same in both themes. As text it is 2.88:1 on light paper, below 4.5:1; keep it to large numerals, rules and fills there.

tokens.name: tint-twoartists
tokens.usage: Story tint, set as --accent on the In conversation: Two artists reimagine the role of art section: chapter rule and numeral, kicker, listen button, running-head tab underline. Same in both themes. As text it is 3.25:1 on light paper, below 4.5:1; keep it to large numerals, rules and fills there.

tokens.name: tint-abs
tokens.usage: Story tint, set as --accent on the Scholarship: Association for Bahá'í Studies at 50 section: chapter rule and numeral, kicker, listen button, running-head tab underline. Same in both themes. As text it is 4.24:1 on light paper, below 4.5:1; keep it to large numerals, rules and fills there.

tokens.name: tint-endeavor
tokens.usage: Story tint, set as --accent on the Across America: Communities engage in a common endeavor section: chapter rule and numeral, kicker, listen button, running-head tab underline. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: tint-comic

Same in both themes. As text it is 1.93:1 on light paper, below 4.5:1; keep it to large numerals, rules and fills there.

styles.name: chapter-numeral
styles.usage: Feature number beside the chapter rule, in the story tint. Fluid: clamp(64px, 9vw, 120px).

styles.name: story-headline
styles.usage: Feature headline, max 14ch, balanced. Fluid: clamp(50px, 9vw, 104px); 76px max on phones.

styles.name: dek
styles.usage: Standfirst under a headline, in mute. Fluid: clamp(20px, 2vw, 28px). Line height inherited from body.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Publication name in the running head.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: Quoted passage on a voice band. Fluid: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 38px).

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes in the text column, italic. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.7vw, 21px).

styles.name: cover-sub
styles.usage: Masthead subtitle, italic. Fluid: clamp(15px, 1.5vw, 20px). Line height inherited from body.

styles.name: nav-tab
styles.usage: Running-head tabs, each underlined 4px in its story tint. Line height inherited from body.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Share and pill buttons. Line height inherited from body.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Prose section heads: uppercase, accent colour, rule above. Line height inherited from body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Margin column (kicker, byline) and chapter labels: uppercase, mute.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Plate captions in mute. Line height inherited from body.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons; small inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-cap
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of plate captions; band caption top margin.

tokens.name: space-cap-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of plate captions and popups; share button right padding.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (.wrap) and chapter rule top padding; never less than the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: space-headline
tokens.usage: Space under a feature headline.

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page column; voice bands run to 1240px.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Focus outlines on tiles, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Square action buttons in the ask and nudge panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small cards and checklist rows.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Dialog inputs and drop zones.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Share, survey and ask dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Share button and nudge pills.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Listen button and chart dots.
